passives.name: Project: Ruler
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). When an enemy performs an action, if the caster's Health is less than or equal to 30%, Demiurge Astei counterattacks, and if the caster's Health is greater than 30%, grants a Barrier to Demiurge Astei for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_boss_2000053_4_3] turn(s). When not Enraged, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_4500043_4_2].
